audit.O1Definition: Track original float32 spatial calculations and real sample support in recorded order. Hold candidate starts at the last reset sample event time. During the receipt interval before the next sample is processed, count time past120ms with drag>=3mm and support<3. Following-sample support requires the next displacement/speed to remain within the same1mm/15mm/s settings. Report geometry separately; these are co-occurrences, not proof that minSamples alone caused abandonment. No synthetic samples, timer grid or alternative lock outcomes.
audit.O2Definition: For each recorded lock, include every raw sample with timeReal<lockObservedTimeReal and receivedReal>lockObservedTimeReal. Displacement uses recorded lockXPx/lockYPx and mmPerPx. Break down by lockOrigin; no inference of involuntary intent.
